{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg2xQucyMgNr7gS1bKG76","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've parallelized `spmv/spmv.cpp` with MPI, and its output matches a serial reference bit for bit. I checked the output hash and sum on 5 matrix configurations, each on 1, 3 and 8 ranks. Validation passed in every run. I did not measure scaling or run larger sizes.\n\nMy serial reference was a re-implementation of the original generator logic, because I had already overwritten `spmv.cpp` when I went to compare. It isn't the original binary.\n\n**How it works**\n- **Row distribution:** each rank owns a block of rows and computes only those.\n- **Random data:** the original builds the matrix by walking one global `rand()` stream, which can't be split across ranks. I added a small reproduction of glibc's `rand()` that can jump to any position in the stream. Each rank now generates only its own rows and values, and gets exactly the serial data. Generation cost is split across ranks instead of repeated on each one.\n- **Counting nonzeros:** ranks first generate their rows assuming the nonzero limit never kicks in, then exchange counts to get their offsets. The original's \"fill the remaining entries\" logic only applies near the end of the matrix. Ranks whose range might reach it regenerate in sequence from the last rank back, which is normally a short chain.\n- **Vector:** each rank generates its slice and an all-gather gives everyone the full vector. It doesn't change between iterations, so no communication happens in the timed loop.\n- **Timing:** the compute loop is timed between barriers, and the slowest rank's time is reported. Output, validation and `-r` printing are gathered or reduced so only rank 0 prints. I added one extra line, `MPI ranks: N`, to the header output.\n\n**Build**\n`CMakeLists.txt` now uses `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The executable is still `spmv`, run with `mpirun -n N ./spmv ...`.\n\nIf `numRows * numRows` exceeds 2^32, the original's 32-bit arithmetic wraps. The MPI version handles that case correctly but falls back to the slow sequential chain."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1922,"cache_read_input_tokens":34186,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1922},"output_tokens":706,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"73fdc0a0-6c82-49fd-b5d5-ccf2082accba","uuid":"c4926434-5a19-4d7c-b92d-088203ff7a16","timestamp":"2026-10-14T22:57:14.433Z","request_id":"req_011Cg2xQtUm5eaQJinKFF6h1"}
